name: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (Science Stream)
benefit:
> **Assistance Details:**

•	11th Standard: ₹15,000/- per annum as a private tuition fees
•	12th Standard: ₹15,000/- per annum as a private tuition fees
_eligibility_text:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
   1. The student should be studying in Standard 11th &amp; 12th Science Stream.
   1. The student should have 70% or more marks in Standard 10th.
   1. The annual family income of the student should be up to ₹6 lakhs.
